description: This file contains test cases for the Recipe schema, including duplication, conversion from dish, and creation from recipe, using the Test2 framework and a mock database.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Test the duplication of a recipe, ensuring the clone has a different ID and matching ingredient count.

methods.name: from_dish
methods.description: Test creating a recipe from a dish, verifying ingredient conversion and attributes.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Test creating a dish from a recipe, verifying attribute copying and ingredient conversion.
